purpose: Local farm sauce workshop and intermediate kitchen building sprites.
processing: Remove tiny detached alpha components, retain a 1px alpha fringe, crop and contain within a transparent 512x512 canvas with 12px padding. Reproduce from repository root with prepare.cjs.
